items.title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls

items.lede: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
items.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
